name: Camping 101: Leatherworking
summary: In Orgrimmar, Karolek can teach you to craft a leatherworker’s tent once you have shown skill in your profession. A tent offers shelter on your travels, though setting camp also calls for a campfire.

sections.title: A Place to Camp
sections.body: A leatherworker in Orgrimmar points you to Karolek, who can teach you to make a tent for your travels. It offers shade on hot days and shelter from rain, giving you a place to rest while journeying. Once you have shown proficiency in leatherworking, Karolek can teach you to craft this camping item.

sections.title: Campfire First
sections.body: Your tent is ready, but a campfire completes the camp. Cooks can teach you to make one, and a cooking trainer can show you the basics. To try your tent, leave the center of town and set it up in the wilderness.

faq.q: Who can teach me to make a leatherworker’s tent?
faq.answer: Karolek in Orgrimmar can teach you to craft a tent after you show proficiency in leatherworking.
The tent gives you shelter from rain and shade on hot days, and offers a place to rest on your travels.

faq.q: Can I set up my tent in town?
faq.answer: The completion text says most people do not care for tents set up in the center of town, so you need to go into the wilderness to try it out.

faq.q: What else do I need to start a camp?
faq.answer: You need a campfire as well as a tent. Cooks can teach you to make a fire.

faq.q: Who can teach me the basics of cooking?
faq.answer: Someone who trains cooks can teach you the basics of the culinary arts.

angles.text: As a cook, you can learn to make the campfire needed to complete a camp.
